# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in any DevSecNinja repository,
please report it responsibly.

**Do NOT open a public issue.**

Instead, please use [GitHub’s private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
by navigating to the **Security** tab of the affected repository and
clicking **Report a vulnerability**.

Alternatively, contact the repository owner directly via GitHub.

## Response

- Acknowledgement within 48 hours.
- A fix or mitigation will be developed and released as soon as
  possible.
- Credit will be given to the reporter unless they prefer to remain
  anonymous.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release on the default branch of each repository is
actively maintained.
